reference.question: Solve \(3(x-1)=9\). (Enter only the value of \(x\).)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Expand first

Expanding gives \(3x-3=9\). Transposing terms gives \(3x=12\), so \(x=4\).

Method 2: Divide first

Here \(3\) multiplies the whole expression \(x-1\). Dividing both sides by the nonzero number \(3\) isolates this expression, giving \(x-1=3\); adding \(1\) to both sides gives \(x=4\).
